edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender argument forwarded to transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared with _from to gate allowance spending in transferFrom.
msg.sender keys the allowance mapping written by approve.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the arbitrary delegatecall in delegate.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates sale configuration in init.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates batch distribution in batchSend.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates trade address rotation in setTradeAddress.
msg.sender becomes the owner and receives the total supply in the constructor.
transfer delegates its logic to transferFrom with msg.sender as sender.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom increments the per-address sale counter _onSaleNum.
transferFrom requires the ensure() gate to pass before moving balances.
transferFrom performs unchecked subtraction on balanceOf[_from], risking underflow.
transferFrom performs unchecked subtraction on allowance[_from][msg.sender].
ensure() compares _from and _to against the owner whitelist.
ensure() reads the canSale whitelist mapping for _from.
ensure() reads tradeAddress as a whitelisted bypass address.
ensure() falls through to condition() when no whitelist applies.
ensure() derives the Uniswap pair via pairFor() for whitelist comparison.
condition() compares the per-address sale count against _saleNum.
condition() validates _value against the minimum sale limit.
condition() validates _value against the maximum sale limit.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the sale count cap.
delegate() executes an attacker-controlled delegatecall target and payload.
init() requires msg.sender to equal the owner state variable.
init() writes the computed minimum sale limit to _minSale.
init() writes the computed maximum sale limit to _maxSale.
init() writes the sale count limit to _saleNum.
init() scales token limits using the decimals constant.
batchSend() requires msg.sender to equal the owner state variable.
batchSend() reads and writes the balanceOf mapping in its loop.
batchSend() computes total as unguarded _value * _tos.length multiplication.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender to equal the owner state variable.
setTradeAddress() writes the new privileged address into tradeAddress.
The constructor stores msg.sender into the owner state variable.
The constructor sets totalSupply from the scaled _supply argument.
The constructor credits the deployer in balanceOf at deployment.
The constructor sets an unlimited allowance for the UNI router.
The constructor uses the UNI constant address for the initial allowance.
The constructor assigns the token name.
The constructor assigns the token symbol.

token parameter is scaled into the _minSale limit.
maxToken parameter is scaled into the _maxSale limit.

_symbol parameter is assigned to the symbol state variable.
_supply parameter is scaled into totalSupply.
